# Evidence contract fixtures

Sanitized captures from the known-note Muse investigation and an authored recorded-mode run. These JSON files are offline test inputs; running the tests makes no provider call. Workspace endpoint identifiers, provider resource identifiers and personal filesystem paths are redacted. Proposal actions, assertions, schedules, observations and source hashes remain intact.

The fixtures exercise evidence validation and rejection paths without a private job database. User-facing captured investigation artifacts are documented in the project evidence guide.
